title: OpenGateway: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Eco
brief: OpenGateway's model page for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Eco, with availability, per-token pricing, endpoints, and provider details for this V4.1 Flash variant on one page. OpenGateway is a unified LLM gateway — one OpenAI-compatible endpoint for every model, with automatic retries, failover chains, live request inspection, and team keys with prepaid credits.
details: OpenGateway's model page for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Eco lists that variant's availability, per-token pricing, endpoints, and provider details in one place, so you can see what the Eco route costs and how to call it before wiring it up. OpenGateway itself is a unified LLM gateway: point any OpenAI SDK at its single endpoint and switch models by changing one string, with routing, authentication, retries, and response normalisation handled for you. It adds a Grafana-style Live Tail for debugging calls in flight, configurable failover chains that reroute on 429, 5xx, or timeouts, and team keys with roles, prepaid credits, and auto-pause spend caps. (Coverage note: written from the OpenGateway homepage and the Discord embed — the model page is client-rendered and was not directly fetchable.)
